notes.title: CONCRETE | Version 1.4.5 | Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h1]GREETINGS EMPLOYEES[/h1]

CONCRETE has been updated to Version 1.4.5, read below for the patch notes.

Just when you thought 1.4.4 was the final update, I'm back! Based off community suggestions, I've made the following changes:


[h2]GENERAL[/h2]
[list]
[*] Statues now break and crumble into pieces when found. Purely a visual addition
[*] Fixed tutorial prompts only showing keyboard mapping even when using a gamepad
[*] Fixed keypad UI not playing nice with gamepads
[/list]

[h2]COLLECTOR MINIGAME[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed achievement "FIRST WEEK ON THE JOB" not triggering when it should have (should also work retroactively now, if you are past day 7 you'll need to finish an additional day for it to trigger)
[*] Added "no access" sign to inaccessible door in the apartment to mirror THE CITY
[/list]

[h2]VERTIGO MINIGAME[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed achievement "SPEEDRUNNER" not triggering when it should have (for real this time!)
[*] Changed achievement "SPEEDRUNNER" to require a time under 3 minutes (was 2 minutes) to allow for a few mistakes and not be so harsh
[*] Minor adjustments around the map to make the jumping easier and less frustrating
[/list]

As always, your feedback is welcome. Send me an email at benjam.pilbrow@gmail.com if you want to get in touch, or feel free to post a comment down below.

Cheers!
[i]Benjamin[/i]

notes.title: CONCRETE | Version 1.4.4 | Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h1]GREETINGS EMPLOYEES[/h1]

CONCRETE has been updated to Version 1.4.4, read below for the patch notes.

[h2]GENERAL[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added number row / numpad input support for keyboard users when interfacing with an in-game keypad
[*] Fixed selected number on keypad becoming hidden when holding a button down and moving the mouse outside of the button area. Now it will always stay visible 
[*] Fixed spelling error in employee terminal
[*] Fixed bug where you could interact and collect a Tape multiple times before it disappeared, adding +1 count to your total each time
[*] Changed button label "RESET USER" in employee terminal to read "CHANGE USERNAME" to avoid confusion as it what the button might do (previously it implied you might be resetting your save progress, which is not the case)
[/list]

[h2]THE CITY[/h2]
[list]
[*] [spoiler] Added new way to get achievement "ROCKET JOCKEY" [/spoiler]
[/list]

[h2]CLEANSER MINIGAME[/h2]
[list]
[*] Removed some useless boxes from around the map
[*] Removed statue from the master bedroom wardrobe
[/list]

[h2]COLLECTOR MINIGAME[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed achievement "DAWN, DUSK, DARK" not triggering when it should have
[*] Fixed achievement "SMORGASBORD" not triggering when it should have (you still need to open the object stats page in your employee terminal to get this achievement)
[/list]

[h2]VERTIGO MINIGAME[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed achievement "SPEEDRUNNER" not triggering when it should have (broken in last patch when I changed the required time to under 2 minutes, now working as intended)
[*] Changed achievement "GETTING OVER IT" to trigger when you fall 25 times (was 100 times)
[/list]

[h3]WHAT'S NEXT?[/h3]
That's it for patch 1.4.4! As far as my testing goes, I believe I have addressed all the major bugs I am aware of. I'm sure I am missing something as this has become quite a large game with lots of moving parts, so please do let me know if you encounter any issues. If any big issues are made known to me I will be sure to work on another patch to fix them, but as for now I am mostly happy with the state of the game (finally!). 

I plan to make a little "CONCRETE: Postmortem" at some point in the future, detailing my experience making the game, the issues I faced, and what I learned. A final dev log of sorts (even though I made no previous dev logs). So if you're interested in that, keep an eye out on my YouTube channel (link at the bottom of the post). 

Other than that, I think that pretty much covers the final update for CONCRETE. Thanks to everyone for all your feedback and support, it's been super fun to watch new people play the game and let me know what they think. This is only the humble beginning of my game development journey and there are many more exciting things to come. If you're reading this now, thanks for being there at the start.

Cheers!
[i]Benjamin[/i]

[list]

[h2]THE FOREST[/h2]
[list]

[*] Smoothed area of ground mesh that was mistakenly extruding into the sky
[*] Added a new achievement for collecting all 3 speed boosts (should activate retroactively)
[*] Added 3 new notes, expanding on some lore details and hinting at speed boost locations

[h3]WHAT'S NEXT?[/h3]
I'm already hard at work on patch 1.4.4 which includes more quality of life additions and general game improvements. Aiming to release sometime in the next few days, depending on how much free time I get away from my studies.

As always, your feedback is welcome. Send me an email at benjam.pilbrow@gmail.com if you want to get in touch, or feel free to post a comment down below.

Cheers!
[i]Benjamin[/i]

notes.title: CONCRETE | Version 1.4 | Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h1]GREETINGS EMPLOYEES[/h1]

CONCRETE has been updated to Version 1.4, read below for the patch notes.

This is the final content update for CONCRETE! It features a new map, "THE FOREST", and a range of general improvements and polish. 


[h2]THE FOREST[/h2]
A map intended for release along with the whole game last October, however due to time constraints and other responsibilities I decided to delay it's release. The time has finally come after many reworks and late nights, so now you can experience the whole of CONCRETE as it was intended!


[h2]OBJECT GRABBING REWORK[/h2]
I've also implemented (with the help of a good friend, thanks John!) a new system for picking up objects which should make the whole process of transporting physics objects around the maps much smoother. They will no longer get caught on corners, fall behind hard to reach location, and should just general play nicer. 


[h2]REVAMPED TUTORIAL[/h2]
I received a lot of valid critique regarding the previous version of the tutorial in CONCRETE, that being the hub level. While the hub remains (now without all the annoying prompts popping up all over the place), I've created a new tutorial experience introduces mechanics simply and methodically. The aim of this stripped down approach is to not overwhelm new players with the range of possible interactions. Previously is was very easy to get lost in the hub which is a bit of a maze, and combing that with introducing basic controls and concepts of the game was a recipe for a not-so-fun-time. Fear not, it's a quick tutorial that doesn't outstay it's welcome!

There's plenty more minor additions, but for the sake of brevity I'll list them bullet point style below:


[h2]NEW FEATURES[/h2]
[list]
[*] New map - THE FOREST
[*] New tutorial / introduction sequence
[*] [strike]New secret level - find all 30 collectable VHS tapes throughout the game and locate a special room in THE FOREST to access[/strike]
[/list]

[h2]GAMEPLAY CHANGES[/h2]
[list]
[*] Reworked object grabbing system
[*] General polish pass across all areas in the game
[*] THE HUB received a minor rework to layout, with the aim to lead players directly into THE CITY after finishing the tutorial
[*] Reworked statue requirements for each level in THE HUB. THE CITY requires 1 statue. THE FOREST requires 3 statues. THE SEWER requires 6 statues.
[*] Refreshed the look and some content of all notes in the game
[*] Other minor under the hood improvements
[/list]


[h2]FINAL THOUGHTS[/h2]
As I mentioned, this will be the final major content update for CONCRETE. I'm sure there are a few bugs and issues I've missed through my testing (I'm only one guy!), so I would totally be open to responding to and addressing any issues that have slipped through the cracks. However, as for future content (whether that be more maps, lore, story, gameplay, etc), this is the end of the road.

It's been a fantastic experience working on CONCRETE throughout the past year and a half, and while the game is by no means perfect I am super proud of the work I could accomplish by myself in my spare time.

While CONCRETE will likely always remain an extremely niche game, I think it's fantastic that a random person like me can pick up an engine, write some code, make some art, and pull it all together into a unique experience you won't find anywhere else, in any other medium. It's totally not going to be everyone's cup of tea, and maybe only a handful of you out there will find enjoyment in the strange and bizarre world I've created, but I think that's awesome. Games don't have to be major best sellers with ideas and concepts that are market-tested and "guaranteed" to succeed. Wide success is great, don't get me wrong, but I enjoy the fact that these days we have space for small weird games. Games can be little, strange, kinda broken, well-meaning, experimental, niche, and from the heart. Like CONCRETE! 

Anyway, that's my soapbox session concluded, thanks for reading and I hope you enjoy the game! This is only the beginning of what I have planned in terms of game development, so if you liked any aspect of CONCRETE make sure to keep an eye out for what I have coming next. 

As always, your feedback and thoughts are welcome! Send me an email at benjam.pilbrow@gmail.com if you want to get in touch. 

Cheers!
[i]Benjamin[/i]

notes.title: CONCRETE | Version 1.3 | Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h1]GREETINGS EMPLOYEES[/h1]

CONCRETE has been updated to Version 1.3, read below for the patch notes.

You can now play CONCRETE (almost) fully with an Xbox controller! Previously gamepads were supported for general gameplay, however they did not work with any menus. That's changed now! You can interact with every menu and interface in the game fully with a controller. The only missing feature is a virtual keyboard for entering text. If you do not have an Xbox controller, you should be able to use the Steam Input feature to remap a PlayStation (or other) controller to the same binds.

I've also hidden a bunch of video tapes around the game in fun and hard to reach locations, so get looking for those!

If you notice anything you think needs fixing then please feel free to send me a bug report at my email, benjam.pilbrow@gmail.com - I welcome any and all feedback.


[h2]GAMEPLAY CHANGES[/h2]
[list]
[*] Controller Support added for menus and gameplay
[*] Tutorial prompts now show either keyboard bind or gamepad bind depending on current input method
[*] New collectable tapes hidden throughout the levels
[*] Important objects now glow red to make them stand out (Keys, Crowbars, Planks, etc)
[*] Removed requirement to find all 7 statues in [THE HUB] before you can progress to new maps
[*] Keys will now respawn if they are deleted (fall out of bounds)
[/list]

That covers everything changed in Version 1.3. I am currently working on at least one more content update, featuring the whole new map [THE FOREST], which I aim to release within the next couple weeks. 

Cheers!
[i]Benjamin[/i]
